core_obligations: Descend X, Y, L, N to finite-type Z-algebras via the five limits lemmas
Identify the P-piece with Mor intersect Hilb^{P,M}
Conclude quasi-compactness from Noetherianity of the Hilbert space

proof_roadmap.step: Descend X, Y, L, N to finite-type Z-algebras via the five limits lemmas
Identify the P-piece with Mor intersect Hilb^{P,M}
Conclude quasi-compactness from Noetherianity of the Hilbert space

difficulty_reason: Prove Mor^{P,M}_B(Y,X) -> B is separated of finite presentation for ample L on X/B and N on Y/B with M = pr1^*N tensor pr2^*L: separatedness and lfp come from lemma-Mor-s-lfp, reducing to quasi-compactness of the open-and-closed P-piece; etale-locally descend Y, X, L, N along Lambda = colim Lambda_i via five Limits lemmas (finite presentation, invertible modules, separatedness, eventual properness, limit-ample); on Noetherian affine B, M is ample (properties-lemma-ample-on-product) and Hilb^{P,M}_{Y x_B X/B} is of finite presentation over B hence Noetherian (lemma-hilb-qc-over-base), and Mor^{P,M}_B(Y,X) = Mor_B(Y,X) intersect Hilb^{P,M} is an open subspace of a Noetherian algebraic space, hence quasi-compact.
